thread:
elaine: Heads up — Alert: backup-uploader uploaded a snapshot to cold-archive (glacier-lite) without SSE-KMS header. Noticed via audit query. Investigating. :exclamation:

sahil: omg. timestamp? can you paste the upload request log line?

elaine: here's the upload log snippet:
```
PUT /cold-backups/2026-03-21/tenant42-snap.bin
x-amz-server-side-encryption: <missing>
authorization: ... role=backup-uploader
user: backup-agent-01
```

kelsey: quick check — is the bucket default encryption disabled on that vendor bucket?

miguel: vendor didn't support bucket-enforce-policy on their endpoint. we provisioned it last week as 'glacier-lite' region. thought we set kms alias `alias/redwood/backups` but apparently not applied.

elaine: root cause seems to be RBAC change from last sprint — we added `allow:s3:PutObject` on backup-uploader for cross-account push during replication, but omitted enforcement condition `s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption`.

sahil: ok can we revoke the role immediately and run reupload? who owns backup agent creds?

kelsey: owner is @miguel for agent deploy. miguel can you rotate the agent keys and revoke temporary grant? add emergency policy to deny uploads without SSE.

miguel: on it. I'll patch bucket policy and rotate creds now. creating deny policy snippet:
```
{
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": "s3:PutObject",
      "Resource": "arn:glacier-lite:::cold-backups/*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringNotEquals": {"s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption": "aws:kms"}
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

sec-bot: automated check: listing objects uploaded without SSE in past 24h: 12 objects, most from backup-agent-01. Flagging for retention review.

elaine: MIGUEL — please add KMS alias `alias/redwood/cold-backups` if missing and bind to CMK with rotation off until we confirm. Also run `audit-log` query: `select * from s3_put where encryption=null and principal=backup-agent-01`.

miguel: done. rotated creds, applied deny policy, added kms alias and re-encrypted all candidates via server-side copy with `--sse aws:kms`.

kelsey: good. next: RBAC changeback — we need to add a condition to the IAM policy granting putObject that enforces `s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption` and a partner-check for vendor header. I'll open a PR.

sahil: also add an integration test in backups e2e that uploads to a fake glacier-lite and asserts encryption headers. If test fails, block deployment. owner: @sahil.

elaine: create a short incident doc in ops-postmortems: timeline, root cause, mitigations, follow-ups (RBAC policy template, CI test, audit alert). I'll draft. :memo:

miguel: we've queued re-ingestion to restore missing snapshots from encrypted primaries. ETA 2 hours.

sec-bot: compliance note: this was a P1 for compliance due to unencrypted tenant data — filing ticket COMPL-2026-58. Please cc legal.

elaine: added legal and compliance to the thread. Action items: revoke/rotate creds (miguel), bucket deny policy (miguel), IAM condition PR (kelsey), CI test (sahil), postmortem doc (elaine). Marking done in 24h scrum. :white_check_mark:
